notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.notes: Made a whopsie, the health for layalists should work correctly now.

notes.title: Loyalist Battles Update!
notes.notes:
With Mordek defeated, there are some hold outs, can you defeat them?

+More achievements added
+Loyalist fights added, defeat them for an Ascension Bonus gain per Ascension
+Improved the Minigame to reward Souls
+Added Offline Reward Multiplier in Gem Shop
+Increased slightly max buyable stats in Battle Screen
+Fixed negative health bug

notes.title: Small update adding a 1000x difficulty option
Mini Update
notes.notes:
V3.4.1.1
+Added Popup above turtle to show levels gained
+Increased max Souls from Billions to Quintillions!

notes.title: Reballancing Update
notes.notes:
V3.4.1.0
+Changed Cat Pet to gather the souls of the dead
+Fixed an issue with FireBlade not giving correct Attack Bonus
+Fixed some spelling mistakes
+Re-balanced costs for Skill Duration (will be adding other ways to progress soon)
+Re-balanced costs for Pet Bonus in ascension shop (spent ascension returned)

notes.title: Calculator Update, Pet Buffs, Bug Removal Service
notes.notes:
V3.3.1.2
+Xenos Calculator can now pull data from the game, click the button lower left of the Main Menu
+Added reward for first Ascension (Or your next Ascension for those who have already Ascended)
+Pets Buffed - Penguin 3x / Cat 0.5x
+Fixed Ascension notification displaying incorrectly
+Removed old Healing Aura texts from Tavern
+Fixed bug in Mini game not resetting when starting again
+Fixed SkyForge allowing you to keep 0,0,0 equipment from crafting
+Fixed bug with Double Leveling of Hero from Tavern

notes.title: V3.3.1.0 Update!
notes.notes:
Mini-game - Small 30 second Mini-game with some rewards, helpful for new players/Those desperate for Gems
Max Level is increased to 2 Billion (Was 1 Billion)
Points in Inner Sanctum, Renamed to Monster Souls
Healing Aura skill changed to Soul Collector, Skill now helps gain Additional Monster Souls
Idle rewards now include Levels + Gems + Souls and start at 1 second
UI Adjusted on Main Battle Screen + Beast Sanctuary + Inner Sanctum
Defend The Kingdom button remade and given Black Outline to be more visible on all screens

Fixed Mordek Health not initializing correctly, this should make Mordek Harder now that he has health.
Fixed Skills being able to be manipulated using the sliders in Mordek Battle
Fixed another bug in Stat Tracker
Fixed Bug with Gems not storing correctly and could lead to players loosing Gems over time

notes.title: Bug Patch
notes.notes:
V3.3.0.1
Bug fix for Max Button eating resources in Rebuild Kingdom Screen
Bug fix for Beast Sanctuary

notes.title: Mordek Bug Patch (Missed mordek 7? Missing a key?)
notes.notes:
Just a quick fix to Mordek 7 being skipped, 
If you have missed out on a key due to this
Use code: mordekkey
This code can only be used once.

notes.title: Game speed limit, Healing Aura, Ascension Changes
notes.notes:
Change Log for V3.0.4.1

+Toggle Progress button is clearer
+Prestige text updated to say ascension bonus' stay
+Health Aura reworked - Gives health over 30 seconds, multiplied by game speed
+Ascension limit lowered to 2m from 5m
+Game speed max now 300X from 150X
+Game speed costing changed to 25 gems + 5 gems per purchase
+New Character teased ;)

notes.title: Visuals / Player Skill Update
notes.notes:
Added Loot Icons when killing an enemy or when pet gets reward, these can be turned off in Main Menu screen
Changed the Player Skills duration and cool down to be real time instead of game time

notes.title: V2.4.1 - Quick Update
notes.notes: Added the ability to disable to health bar, in case you hate the flickering

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Appologies, the cloud save launch did not go well.

We encountered some problems with the uploading process, but we have implemented some temporary fixes to restore the functionality as soon as possible.

We will work on improving the cloud save feature in the future. :(

We apologise for any inconvenience caused by this issue.
